_comment: Robots, policies and the actions Nemotron may assign. Keys starting with _ are comments.

nemotron._comment: model_id empty = use the model id from the Nemotron Brain panel. snapshot_valid_for_s: a reasoning model can need 10-40 s per decision; the decision is re-checked against the live fleet before it runs, so a long window is safe.

schedule._comment: routine_inspections false: robots only react to alarms and events. true: every asset is also inspected every default_interval_s of RUNNING time (the clock stops while the simulation is paused or stopped). Can be switched in the Run Fleet panel.

locations._comment: Set to your scene: pose = [x, y, yaw_rad]

inspect.label: Inspect gauge
inspect.description: Go to the asset and capture a clear image of its pressure gauge; the VLM checks the reading against the asset's limits. Out of limits starts a repair.

reinspect.label: Re-inspect gauge
reinspect.description: Go to the asset again and capture a clear gauge image; the VLM confirms whether the pressure is back within limits. Still out of limits repeats the repair.

pickup_tool.label: Pick up repair tools
pickup_tool.description: Go to the tool box, pick up the tool kit and place it on the AMR.

amr_tool_delivery._comment: Automatic, not chosen by Nemotron: after tools are loaded the nearest idle AMR takes them to the asset.

g1.label: Unitree G1
g1.unavailable_reason: pick-up policy in training: set policy_path and env_yaml_path, then available = true
